news.title: Diluting uranium, oil sales: What's in the draft US-Iran deal?
news.summary: Senior US officials on Wednesday disclosed the contents of a draft memorandum of understanding with Iran, ending days of secrecy ahead of a planned signing ceremony on Friday. The document outlines an immediate ceasefire, steps toward lifting US sanctions, the restoration of commercial shipping and negotiations on Iran’s nuclear programme.
news.source: France 24 - International breaking news, top stories and headlines
